_comment: navya-1b RUN config — the 338M ladder rung (Navya-1B in master_plan; NOT 1-billion — that is Navya-2). Shape = 300m.json research shape. Budget: 7,200 steps x 2.097M tokens/step = 15.1B tokens from the ~21.6B-token bank (~44 tok/param, ~2x Chinchilla — deliberate overtraining). LR 1e-3 from the completed pre-1b fixed-token sweep (monotone through 2e-4..1e-3: final vals 3.745/3.468/3.423/3.348/3.344; zero spikes; 1e-3 wins per-domain incl. Indic — pending the 1.2e-3 bracket probe; sweep_analysis.json). Cooldown stream (MIX_1B.md mix) takes over for the last 15% of steps — build data/navya1b_cooldown BEFORE launch; cooldown_data_dir is part of the resume fingerprint. batch_size/grad_accum are GLOBAL (train.py DDP: identical data at any world size); grad_accum 32 divides 1/2/4/8 GPUs. peak_flops default = A100 BF16 dense (the provisioned GCP box); override with NAVYA_PEAK_FLOPS (A10 125e12, H100 989e12, B200 2250e12). | v2 2026-08-21: dress rehearsal of the navya-2 recipe — streams data/navya1b_v2 (15B, mix-navya1b-v2-main → launch variant) + data/navya1b_v2_cooldown (2.25B); selection --bin-include '\.s[45]\.bin$' for global English; venue 8x spot A100-40GB (GCP us-central1) via run_navya.sh; lr 1e-3 (closed sweep); zero1 on (free). | 2026-08-21 FIX: A100-40GB rehearsal — micro-batch 4 x grad_accum 128 (2.097M-token global batch, same data), activation checkpointing on, ce_chunk 1024; unchunked/large-micro OOM'd (64K-vocab logits + activations > 40GB). ZeRO-1 disabled for this run: the ZeroRedundancyOptimizer path OOM'd on init at 8 ranks (fills 40GB) while single-GPU is fine — plain DDP (338M states ~5GB/rank) fits with room. ZeRO integration to debug before it's needed (8B+).
